textures.broadleaf: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: photographic PBR base color texture for the existing shaped geometry of one green subtropical broadleaf in a real-time 3D forest. One square image showing ONLY continuous green LEAF SURFACE across every pixel, no background and no cutout silhouette. Straight orthographic macro scan, the central midrib runs vertically exactly at x=50% from the bottom edge to top edge; delicate natural branching secondary veins fan upward on both sides, fine reticulated smaller veins, subtle chlorophyll mottling, restrained lighter midrib and darker green interveinal tissue, tiny natural imperfections. Healthy olive emerald green, natural medium brightness, slightly asymmetrical detail, low to moderate contrast, neutral flat diffuse cross-polarized light, no cast shadow, no baked sunlight, no glossy white highlights, no water droplets. Entire leaf skin is sharp. No leaf outline, stem, surrounding plants, black or white margins, bark, text or symbols. This is albedo for a mesh already shaped like a leaf, not a photograph of leaves lying on a table. 1024x1024.
